finalText:
I made all nine flight changes from yesterday's queue, posted the charges, and resolved each request with a note to the customer.

The plan gave the dates as 2026-10-05 (today) and 2026-10-04 (yesterday), but the system's date is **2026-07-28**. I used the system dates, so "yesterday" meant the requests received on 2026-07-27. Q-306 is a cancellation request, not a flight change, so I left it open for the team that owns it.

Every new flight is scheduled and had seats in the customer's cabin. No cabin changed and no refunds were due.

| Request | Change | Charged | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q-301 R5201 | AA210 → DL542, 08-06, economy | $0 | The Chicago weather waiver (PB-2026-14) covers it: ticket bought by 07-24, Chicago travel on 08-03. |
| Q-302 R5202 | AA660 → AA664, 08-07, economy | $75 change fee + $35 fare difference | This is a Boston flight, so the Chicago waiver doesn't apply and the normal rules do. |
| Q-303 R5203 | AA662 → AA664, 08-07, basic economy | $150 change fee + $25 fare difference | The customer cited the hurricane waiver PB-2026-09, but it ended 07-15 and only covered Boston travel from 07-01 to 07-20. The $150 basic economy fee comes from bulletin PB-2026-16, which replaces the $125 still shown in the fare rules. |
| Q-304 R5204 | UA88 → UA90, 08-09, basic economy | $35 fare difference | The waiver covers the change fee. Basic economy fares still pay the fare difference under the waiver. |
| Q-305 R5205 | AA214 → AA216, 08-08, economy | $75 change fee + $10 fare difference | The ticket was bought 07-26, after the waiver's 07-24 cutoff. |
| Q-307 R5207 | AA212 → AA218, 08-08, economy | $0 | Platinum member. Amendment PB-2026-14A extends the waiver to 08-05 for gold and platinum members. |
| Q-308 R5208 | AA660 → AA662, same day 08-05, economy | $75 change fee | The same-day change rule (PB-2026-12) charges a flat $75 and no fare difference. Bulletin PB-2026-17 says to use the cheapest bulletin that applies, and the normal rules would have cost $88. |
| Q-309 R5209 | Second flight only: AA1402 → AA1406 on 08-03, economy | $0 | The Chicago waiver covers this trip and is cheaper than the $75 same-day fee. The first flight is unchanged and the connection has a 7.5-hour gap. |
| Q-310 R5210 | AA210 → AA216, 08-08, economy | $75 change fee + $30 fare difference | The customer asked for the Chicago waiver, but each booking gets one free move and this one used it on 07-26. |

Each change fee and fare difference is its own ledger entry (L1–L10).
